propositions: The DC harness session-start field readiness gate waits for Epic Link/Epic Name fields before any Jira Software project is created, but GreenHopper only provisions these fields when the first project is created, causing an ordering deadlock.

The bug is not a timing/budget issue: experiment run 30981084637 proved that 180 seconds of idle waiting produced no field change, but field registration occurred within 0.05 seconds of project creation, demonstrating the capability depends on an action not timing.

The decision rule in not_ready_message ('no customfield_* entries means plugin is starting, budget is too short') is self-confirming and incorrect for instances with no projects, leading all readers to blame the wrong component.
The fix relocates the Epic field check from session start to immediately after project provisioning in _assert_project_capabilities, the only place where the fields can exist.

Verification run 30982731669 achieved 62 passed, 1 xfailed with 0 failed and 0 errored cells, with measured field registration times (0.032-0.058s) supporting a 120-second budget sized at ~2400x the observation.
